prompt: Work in the provided TaskForge PowerShell CLI fixture. Inspect the existing source and tests before changing anything. Add durable single-step `undo` for successful `add`, `complete`, and `remove` mutations. Store the minimal prior state beside the selected data file using atomic writes. `undo` must work in a new process, restore exact task content and ordering, consume the undo record after success, and fail without changing storage when no undo is available. A failed mutation must not replace a valid undo record. Support `--json` summaries. Preserve all existing commands, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/undo.txt` and integrate it so successful non-JSON undo displays the banner once, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `UNDO`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$bannerPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/undo.txt'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

function Read-TaskStoreForTest {
    param([string]$Path)

    return @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $Path -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json)
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $undoRemove = Invoke-TaskForge @('undo', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($undoRemove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'undo remove should succeed in a new process'
    $undoRemoveSummary = $undoRemove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($undoRemoveSummary.undone -eq 'remove' -and $undoRemoveSummary.taskId -eq 1) 'undo remove should return a JSON summary'
    $restoredTask = @(Read-TaskStoreForTest -Path $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($restoredTask.Count -eq 1 -and $restoredTask[0].description -eq 'Fixture test' -and
        $restoredTask[0].status -eq 'completed') 'undo remove should restore exact task content'

    $undoConsumedSnapshot = Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw
    $undoConsumed = Invoke-TaskForge @('undo', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($undoConsumed.ExitCode -ne 0 -and $undoConsumed.Output.Contains('No undo is available.')) 'undo should fail when its record was consumed'
    Assert-True ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw) -eq $undoConsumedSnapshot) 'failed undo should not change task storage'

    $completeDataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'complete.json'
    [void](Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Pending task', '--data-file', $completeDataFile))
    $beforeComplete = Get-Content -LiteralPath $completeDataFile -Raw
    [void](Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $completeDataFile))
    $undoComplete = Invoke-TaskForge @('undo', '--data-file', $completeDataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($undoComplete.ExitCode -eq 0 -and ($undoComplete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).undone -eq 'complete') 'undo complete should return a JSON summary'
    Assert-True ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $completeDataFile -Raw) -eq $beforeComplete) 'undo complete should restore the exact prior store'

    $addDataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'add.json'
    [void](Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Existing', '--description', 'Keep me', '--data-file', $addDataFile))
    $beforeAdd = Get-Content -LiteralPath $addDataFile -Raw
    [void](Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Temporary', '--data-file', $addDataFile))
    $undoAdd = Invoke-TaskForge @('undo', '--data-file', $addDataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($undoAdd.ExitCode -eq 0 -and ($undoAdd.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).undone -eq 'add') 'undo add should return a JSON summary'
    Assert-True ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $addDataFile -Raw) -eq $beforeAdd) 'undo add should restore the exact prior store'

    $orderDataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'order.json'
    [void](Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'One', '--description', 'First', '--data-file', $orderDataFile))
    [void](Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Two', '--description', 'Second', '--data-file', $orderDataFile))
    [void](Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Three', '--description', 'Third', '--data-file', $orderDataFile))
    $beforeRemove = Get-Content -LiteralPath $orderDataFile -Raw
    [void](Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '2', '--data-file', $orderDataFile))
    [void](Invoke-TaskForge @('undo', '--data-file', $orderDataFile, '--json'))
    Assert-True ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $orderDataFile -Raw) -eq $beforeRemove) 'undo remove should restore exact ordering and content'

    $failedMutationDataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'failed-mutation.json'
    [void](Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Undo survives', '--data-file', $failedMutationDataFile))
    $failedMutation = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $failedMutationDataFile)
    Assert-True ($failedMutation.ExitCode -ne 0) 'failed mutation should report failure'
    $undoAfterFailure = Invoke-TaskForge @('undo', '--data-file', $failedMutationDataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($undoAfterFailure.ExitCode -eq 0 -and ($undoAfterFailure.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).undone -eq 'add') 'failed mutation should preserve the previous undo record'
    Assert-True (@(Read-TaskStoreForTest -Path $failedMutationDataFile).Count -eq 0) 'undo add should restore the empty prior store'

    $bannerDataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'banner.json'
    [void](Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Banner task', '--data-file', $bannerDataFile))
    $bannerUndo = Invoke-TaskForge @('undo', '--data-file', $bannerDataFile)
    Assert-True ($bannerUndo.ExitCode -eq 0 -and ([regex]::Matches($bannerUndo.Output, 'UNDO')).Count -eq 1) 'non-JSON undo should display the banner once'
    [void](Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'JSON task', '--data-file', $bannerDataFile))
    $jsonUndo = Invoke-TaskForge @('undo', '--data-file', $bannerDataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($jsonUndo.ExitCode -eq 0 -and -not $jsonUndo.Output.Contains('UNDO')) 'JSON undo should be banner-free'

    $banner = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($bannerPath)
    $bannerLines = $banner.TrimEnd("`n").Split("`n")
    Assert-True ($banner.EndsWith("`n") -and -not $banner.EndsWith("`n`n") -and -not $banner.Contains("`r")) 'banner should end with exactly one LF newline'
    Assert-True ($bannerLines.Count -eq 12) 'banner should contain exactly 12 lines'
    Assert-True (@($bannerLines | Where-Object { $_.Length -lt 20 -or $_.Length -gt 48 -or $_ -notmatch '^[A-Z0-9 +|/\\_*\.#():=-]+$' }).Count -eq 0) 'banner lines should satisfy length and character constraints'
    Assert-True ($banner.Contains('UNDO') -and @($bannerLines | Where-Object { $_ -match '\s$' }).Count -eq 0) 'banner should contain UNDO without trailing whitespace'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge') -and $help.Output.Contains('undo')) 'help should include undo'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: TaskForge fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
